sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Go to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Weather Effect”
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate
  5. Go to Weather Effect in your admin menu to configure

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file from WordPress.org
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the downloaded zip file and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. Go to Weather Effect in your admin menu to configure

Configuration

  1. After activation, go to Weather Effect in your WordPress admin menu
  2. Select your preferred weather season/occasion
  3. Choose the falling objects you want to display
  4. Customize speed, size, and quantity settings
  5. Click Preview to see your changes
  6. Click Save to apply the effects to your website

That’s it! Your website now has beautiful weather effects!
sections.faq:
What is Weather Effect and what does it do?

Weather Effect is a WordPress plugin that adds beautiful animated falling effects to your website. You can display snow falling, rain drops, autumn leaves, Christmas decorations, Halloween bats, Valentine hearts, and many more seasonal animations to enhance your website’s visual appeal.

Do I need coding skills to use this plugin?

No coding skills are required! Weather Effect has an intuitive settings panel where you can simply select your preferred weather effect, customize the settings, and save. The live preview feature lets you see changes in real-time.

Will Weather Effect slow down my website?

No, Weather Effect is built with performance in mind. The plugin uses optimized JavaScript that runs smoothly without affecting your website’s loading speed or performance.

Is Weather Effect compatible with my theme?

Yes! Weather Effect is compatible with all standard WordPress themes and works seamlessly with popular page builders like Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder, WPBakery, and more.

Can I use multiple effects at the same time?

Yes, in the Pro version you can combine multiple falling objects to create unique and customized seasonal effects for your website.

How do I preview the effects before publishing?

After configuring your settings, click the “Preview” button next to the Save button. This will reload the page and show you exactly how the effect will appear to your visitors.

Can I add my own custom images as falling objects?

Yes! The Pro version allows you to upload up to 10 custom images in PNG, JPEG, or GIF format. You can use transparent PNG images or animated GIFs for unique effects.

Can I exclude certain pages from showing the effects?

Yes, the Pro version includes an option to exclude specific pages or posts where you don’t want the weather effects to appear.

What seasonal occasions does this plugin support?

Weather Effect supports: Christmas, Winter, Autumn, Spring, Summer, Rain, Halloween, Thanksgiving, Valentine’s Day, New Year, and Birthday celebrations.

Is the plugin mobile responsive?

Yes, Weather Effect works on all devices including desktops, tablets, and mobile phones. The animations are optimized for smooth performance across all screen sizes.

How do I get support if I have issues?

For free plugin support, please post your questions on the WordPress.org support forum. For Pro version users, we offer priority support through our website.

What is included in the Pro version?

The Pro version includes 50+ falling objects, 10 seasonal themes, custom image upload (up to 10 images), page/post exclusion, speed controls, size randomization, timeout settings, and premium support.
